h: Obi says the President has spent about 200 days abroad but has yet to visit Kogi
p: Peter Obi has criticised President Tinubu's foreign travel, saying he has spent roughly 200 days outside the country while still not visiting Kogi State. The Presidency has previously argued that the President governs effectively wherever he is.
more: Obi has repeated the travel-days argument several times this year.
The Presidency has said the President works from abroad as well.
